Sections.title: General Map and Report Review
Sections.subtitle: Florida baseline; apply data-related items to the work performed.

items.title: Purpose and Scope
items.statement: Identify the product type and intended purpose.

items.title: Horizontal Control and Accuracy
items.statement: State the horizontal datum and control; retain independent accuracy checks and methods.

items.title: Vertical Control and Accuracy
items.statement: For elevation data, state datum and control and document accuracy and verification methods.

items.title: Assumed Datum Control
items.statement: If using an assumed datum, distinguish it from published datums and provide reproducible control.

items.title: Dated Supporting Records
items.statement: Retain dated measurements and computations supporting the product.

items.title: Responsible Surveyor and Business
items.statement: Show responsible surveyor name/license and issuing business name, authorization number, and street/mailing addresses.

items.title: Acquisition and Revision Dates
items.statement: Identify the last acquisition date and subsequent graphic revision dates.

items.title: Signature and Seal Statement
items.statement: Include the required original-signature/seal validity statement unless electronically signed and sealed.

items.title: Map Orientation and Legend
items.statement: Show north, scale, defined survey abbreviations, and the bearing reference to an established monumented line.

items.title: Mapped Feature Responsibility
items.statement: Identify responsibility for mapped features and integration of others' work.

items.title: Final Delivery Review
items.statement: Confirm signed/sealed deliverables, sheet references, filenames, revision consistency, and contracted formats before release.

items.title: Minor Plat Classification
items.statement: Confirm the jurisdiction recognizes a minor plat process and document the governing criteria; do not assume a statewide lot-count threshold.

items.title: Minor Plat Process Eligibility
items.statement: Verify lot count, prior divisions, road/improvement proposals, and other local eligibility conditions for this project.

items.title: Applicable Plat Requirements
items.statement: Confirm applicable Chapter 177 and local requirements; do not assume the minor designation waives platting standards.

items.title: Minor Plat Submission Path
items.statement: Confirm review authority, application materials, signatures, approval sequence, and recording instructions.

items.title: Boundary Survey Support
items.statement: Provide the boundary survey required for initial submittal; document any applicable replat exception.

items.title: Title and Mortgage Evidence
items.statement: Obtain the required title opinion or property information report identifying owners and unreleased mortgages.

items.title: Sheet Format and Index
items.statement: Check recording medium, margins, sheet format, index, numbering, and matchlines.

items.title: Plat Identification and Scale
items.statement: Check subdivision name, surveyor/business address, location, scale, north, and bearing reference on required sheets.

items.title: Permanent Reference Monuments
items.statement: Verify PRM placement, spacing, identification, offsets, and installation before recording.

items.title: Permanent Control Points
items.statement: Check applicable PCP placement, spacing, depiction, and installation deadline.

items.title: Interior Corner Monuments
items.statement: Check required corner monuments, permitted exceptions, and installation timing.

items.title: Plat and Title Description Agreement
items.statement: Match the plat description to title certification; ensure the boundary can be determined independently.

items.title: Dedications and Review Evidence
items.statement: Verify owner execution, mortgagee joinder, and evidence of required surveyor review.

items.title: Approvals and Certificates
items.statement: Show required approvals, clerk certificate, and surveyor seal and statement.

items.title: Boundary and Adjoining Information
items.statement: Show required government lines, description calls, adjoining identification, and replat ties.

items.title: Rights-of-Way and Easements
items.statement: Show rights-of-way and easement locations, widths, purposes, and required ties.

items.title: Lot and Curve Geometry
items.statement: Check numbering, boundary data, dimensions, bearings, curves, centerlines, units, and precision.

items.title: Special Areas and Tables
items.statement: Identify recreation, excepted, and dedicated areas; place tables on applicable sheets.

items.title: Required Notices and Legend
items.statement: Include statutory notices, applicable utility-easement provisions, and a complete legend.

items.title: Minor Plat Computations
items.statement: Independently verify parent and resulting parcel closure, area balance, shared lines, curves, and retained land.

items.title: Minor Plat Access and Rights
items.statement: Check access to each parcel, existing/proposed easements, dedications, and affected rights.

items.title: Minor Plat Final Package
items.statement: Reconcile plat, survey, title evidence, approval conditions, and revision responses before release.

items.title: Minor Plat Completion Tracking
items.statement: Record approval/recording references and track any permitted deferred monumentation obligations.
